subject: SageTech demo — hold until vendor intake & NDA
messages:
From: Emily Harris <emily.harris@sagetech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sagetech.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo request & procurement gating

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We reviewed Redwood internally and are excited to see a demo — we were hoping to book 60 minutes next Thursday (May 6) to walk through the hosted API and Dedicated options.

One wrinkle: our procurement and security teams require an executed NDA and a completed vendor questionnaire before any technical demo with our product engineering team. I've attached the questionnaire and our standard PO terms so you can see what they're asking for.

If we run the demo before intake is complete, procurement will likely cancel or require we re-run the session with different attendees, which wastes everyone's time. Can you confirm whether Redwood can a) accept our NDA (we can route via DocuSign), and b) fill out the attached questionnaire and send any SOC2/pen-test artifacts to procurement@sagetech.com?

If those items are going to take more than a few business days, we would prefer to push the demo until intake is cleared. If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute vendor-intake call with procurement this week to accelerate.

Attachments: SageTech_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (questionnaire), SageTech_PO_terms.docx (standard T&Cs)

Thanks — Emily
Emily Harris
Head of Platform Partnerships
SageTech
emily.harris@sagetech.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Harris <emily.harris@sagetech.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo request & procurement gating

Hi Emily — really appreciate the clarity and for sending the questionnaire.

Short answer: we can absolutely take the questionnaire and the NDA route. Two quick options:

1) If procurement is willing to run a 20-minute intake call this week (we can join with our security lead), we can answer questions live and often that short-circuits a lot of back-and-forth.
2) If procurement prefers we complete the questionnaire offline, please confirm who to send the completed PDF to (procurement@sagetech.com?) and whether we should submit SOC2 and pen-test artifacts to a secure intake email or via a file-sharing link.

We don't want to waste your engineering team's time. If intake is likely to be >72 hours, let's push the full technical demo until we have NDAs + questionnaire complete. We can tentatively hold a few backup times the week after next if that helps planning.

Connor — looping you on this one to pick up the intake call if we do it live and to surface SOC2 artifacts.

Emily — happy to route the DocuSign NDA from our legal team if you confirm the signer.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo request & procurement gating (SageTech)

Connor / Marissa — forwarding Emily's note. Quick asks: 

- Connor: can you pull the latest SOC2 report and our latest pen-test summary and prepare the Redacted-Artifact bundle we usually send for vendor intake? If procurement wants a live intake call, can you join this week (end-of-day Friday is their preferred slot) and bring the intake checklist: legal NDA cadence, artifact delivery method, timeline estimate.

- Marissa: please tentatively hold our demo engineer calendar for May 17-19 as candidate windows (1-2 slots each day, afternoons). We'll keep these tentative until procurement confirms.

Goal: avoid scheduling the full product demo until intake is closed. If procurement insists on a demo as part of intake, we can do a 20-min vendor-intake walkthrough rather than a product deep-dive.

Attachments from prospect: SageTech_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf, SageTech_PO_terms.docx

Thanks — Grace

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Harris <emily.harris@sagetech.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo request & procurement gating

Hi Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per procurement's guidance, we'll pause the full technical demo until the NDA is executed and the questionnaire is completed. That will ensure your engineers get a focused session.

Proposed next steps:
- We'll send a DocuSign NDA today to the signer you confirm.
- Connor will prepare and send the redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary to procurement@sagetech.com and upload artifacts to a secure share if requested.
- Once procurement confirms intake is closed, can you confirm one of the following windows for the demo? May 17 (afternoon), May 18 (late morning), May 19 (afternoon). We'll convert one slot to a calendar invite once you confirm.

If procurement would still like a short intake / orientation call this week to speed things up, Connor is available Friday 4–5pm PT.

Thanks again — looking forward to working through intake and getting a productive demo scheduled.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0187
